gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests {@link UnsynchronizedByteArrayInputStream#read(byte[], int, int)}, the explicit offset/length read overload.
ADDED i2: Creates a stream backed by the given bytes. The builder declares a checked {@link IOException}, but it can never be thrown here because no conversion is needed
ADDED i3: An empty stream always reports end-of-stream and never touches the destination buffer, regardless of the requested offset/length window.
ADDED i4: Requesting zero bytes reads nothing (returns 0) even when data is available.
ADDED i5: Partial then remaining reads: a 3-byte stream read in chunks of 2 then up to 10.
ADDED i6: First read: ask for 2 bytes, get the first 2 (0xa, 0xb); the rest of the buffer is untouched.
ADDED i7: Second read: ask for up to 10 bytes, but only the final byte (0xc) remains.
ADDED i8: Reads into a fresh 10-byte buffer from an empty stream and asserts that the read reports end-of-stream while leaving the buffer all-zeros. @param offset the des
